purpose.primary: Validate every Stage 6 run-level candidate on unused simulator-seed blocks and freeze the candidates or candidate regions sent to the final test.
purpose.secondary: Quantify exploration-to-validation optimism and compare generated candidates with no intervention, the spring reference, and the exact prior-study package benchmark.
not_in_scope: reporting validation estimates as final performance
claiming that certainty and effectiveness alone reproduce the exact prior_high package
testing a universal candidate shared across networks
declaring one optimization method generally superior

objective.name: cumulative_selfish_fraction
objective.scope: Validate and select candidates separately for each network.

candidate_source.policy: Evaluate all 54 candidates. Do not remove or merge candidates before validation.

fairness_rules: Evaluate every candidate and comparator on the same three simulator-seed blocks within its network.
Use the same 100 iterations, retained raw level, agent settings, information settings, timing, and initial-source settings for every condition.
Treat a Stage 6 candidate as a network-specific condition; never apply a candidate from one network to another network in Stage 7.
Use the applied four-decimal certainty and effectiveness values saved by Stage 6.
Keep method and optimizer-replicate labels only as candidate provenance; do not reserve shortlist positions by method.
Do not use a validation result to add, remove, or alter a candidate before all 189 runs are complete.

seed_policy.final_test_use_policy: Do not execute or inspect final-test seeds until Stage 7 selection is frozen.

inference.policy: Report continuous estimates and intervals; do not invent a post-hoc magnitude threshold.

selection_rule.scope: Apply independently within each network and only to the 18 Stage 6 candidates.

block_rank.metric: mean cumulative_selfish_fraction within each validation simulator-seed block

prior_high_reference.reason: prior_high reproduces an exact prior-study opinion package whose non-design-variable fields are not assumed reachable by changing only certainty and effectiveness

eligibility.reason: The three validation blocks are used for robust direction and ranking; interval width is reported but not converted into an arbitrary pass threshold.

region_grouping.purpose: Interpret nearby qualifying candidates as one observed good region; do not infer untested points inside the region are good.

shortlist.representative: best ordered eligible candidate in each region
shortlist.when_eligible_candidates_exist: Select representatives only from eligible regions, up to the maximum.
shortlist.when_no_eligible_candidate_exists: Select up to three best-ranked distinct regions as exploratory fallback and set the network decision to no_qualified_candidate.

interpretation_limits: Validation estimates are used for selection and are not final performance estimates.
A positive validation effect does not authorize a final generalization claim.
Region bounds summarize observed candidates only and do not validate every interior parameter value.
The reserved final-test seeds remain unused throughout Stage 7.
